# Bulgarian and English wordings to review

<!-- GENERATED by `cd server && ../.venv/bin/python -m i18n.review_table`. Do not edit; change the flag list in server/i18n/review_table.py and regenerate. `--check` exits 1 when this file is stale. -->

This is the list of wordings that earlier work on the Bulgarian/English switch was NOT sure about. Nothing here is broken: the app uses the wording shown. For each row please say keep, or write the wording you want in the last column; the developer then changes the one place named in the key and removes the row.

How to read it: **Key** says where the text lives (kind and name), **EN** and **BG** are the texts the app prints now, **Why** is the doubt and the slice that raised it. `{name}`, `{n}` and similar are filled in by the app; `{n|a|b}` picks form `a` for 1 and form `b` otherwise. Names of game content (classes, spells, feats, items) stay English in both languages on purpose and are not listed.
